comments:
The author is named "chos kyi seng ge" in the colophon, and it is indicated that he was a disciple of Bya 'dul (ID:3818). This supports the identification as Phya pa (ID:3831).

The author refers to the views of unidentified scholars and teachers (slob dpon) as well as those of his own bla ma - ex009042025-12-0113-10-51, ex009042025-12-0113-23-38 -  likely Bya 'dul 'dzin (ID:3818), whom he refers to in the colophon ex9042023-09-09-948 . He also quotes views by "blo gros chen po" ex009042025-12-0113-39-04 and "bshes gnyen" ex009042025-12-0113-10-52 .

Whether the author is identical with the "dharma singha" who authored another commentary on the kārikā and a commentary on the kārikāvṛtti - see (ID:5524) and (ID:4509) - deserves further investigation. The present text has large parallels to (ID:5524), which is however more detailed has more frequent mention and refutation of alternative views, but the present text refers to the base text more systematically.
